verdict.rationale: A government online filing and records service could plausibly offer a natural-language or conversational interface, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only web forms, mail-in filing, and phone support from human representatives. Probes found no llms.txt, markdown docs, or OpenAPI spec, and showed agent access blocked on the filing host and disallowed on the Business Express portal.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
